question: Explain the clinical rationale connecting a patient's diabetes diagnosis to their statin therapy (show the connecting path).
answer:
## How a diabetes diagnosis connects to statin therapy

The protocol doesn't link diabetes to statins directly. The link goes through the HEDIS **SPD (Statin Therapy for Patients With Diabetes)** measure. A diabetes code puts a patient in the diabetes cohort. Being in that cohort and aged 40–75 makes them eligible for SPD. The care protocol then names statins as the recommended therapy for SPD. [SPD (Statin Therapy)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/discover/pages/90137b0e-d1a0-4667-aea0-8aff1f754984?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668) [Knowledge snippet]
